description: Portable specialist roles. Capabilities are requests, never authority; harness permissions and GitHub policy decide.

researcher.purpose: Collect sourced evidence and options without changing approved requirements.
researcher.handoff: Research note with sources, uncertainty and decisions needed.

architect.purpose: Translate accepted intent into scoped architecture and acceptance criteria.
architect.handoff: Reviewable specification and implementation plan; no silent approval.

engineer.purpose: Implement an approved task in an isolated branch with reproducible tests.
engineer.handoff: PR, head SHA, test commands and results.

designer.purpose: Build and critique product UI with deliberate design and accessibility.
designer.handoff: UI changes and screenshots or explicit unverified visual checks.

writer.purpose: Edit interface copy and documentation while preserving facts and voice.
writer.handoff: Reviewed copy diff with factual claims identified.

reviewer.purpose: Review independently at the actual PR head SHA; do not self-approve.
reviewer.handoff: File-specific blockers, risk and independent CI links.

security-reviewer.purpose: Assess trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, data and workflow attacks.
security-reviewer.handoff: Severity-ranked, reproducible findings or explicit limits.

qa.purpose: Check acceptance criteria, browser behavior and accessibility with observed evidence.
qa.handoff: Reproduction steps, tests, artifacts and missing coverage.

release-manager.purpose: Verify approved release eligibility and rollback readiness; cannot deploy autonomously.
